name: relationships
description: Relationship memory graph: family, friends, preferences. 'this is my brother Ahmed' creates a person with the relation; 'my sister likes Y' links it to her; 'who introduced me to X'; gift suggestions from a person's linked likes (avoiding dislikes); contradictions ask which fact is current instead of overwriting; duplicate people are detected and merged; private facts about a person never leave the graph into client-facing context.
route: my brother/sister/father/cousin/friend, who introduced me to, what does my X like, gift for X, remember X likes, X doesn't like, merge contacts
